company.name: Ansa Biotechnologies
company.shortDescription: Ansa Biotechnologies develops a novel DNA synthesis technology based on enzymes.
company.description: Ansa Biotechnologies is manufactured via a chemical method that has remained essentially unchanged for 35 years and has approached a plateau. Ansa Biotechnologies is developing a novel DNA synthesis technology based on enzymes that will be more fast, accurate, and clean than existing methods. The technique promises to dramatically accelerate innovation in biological research and engineering.

aiResearchSummary.text: Ansa Biotechnologies is researching de novo stepwise template independent synthesis of long polynucleotides, directed evolution methods for template independent polymerases, modified terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase polymerases, and reversible terminators with enzyme cleavable linkages. They develop cleavable linkers tethering polymerases to nucleotides, compositions for enzymatic polynucleotide synthesis, improved cloning of de novo synthesized polynucleotides, and methods and systems for cyclic enzymatic polymer synthesis.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $46,449,665, or 35.77% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $1,219,682, representing 0.94% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,727,851 to $344,509,360, a 51.21x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
